description:

In the upcoming match between DN SOOPers and Kiwoom DRX in the LCK Round 3-4 Rise Group, initially scheduled for August 22, 2026 at 7:20 AM ET:

This market is about the total kills in Game 2.

This market will resolve to "Over" if the total kills in Game 2 is 22 or more. Otherwise, it will resolve to "Under".

If the match is canceled (not played at all), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match is postponed, it must be rescheduled to a start time on or before September 5, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET (14 calendar days after the originally scheduled start of August 22, 2026 at 7:20 AM ET). If, by that deadline, the most recently announced rescheduled start time is on or before the deadline, this market resolves based on the result of the match as played. Otherwise, this market resolves 50-50, regardless of whether the match is subsequently played.

If Game 2 is never played due to forfeit, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 2 begins but is not completed, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 2 is remade, resolution will be based on the total kills in the remade game only.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

eventMetadata.context_description: DN SOOPers enter this LCK Rise Group BO3 with clear momentum after capturing the 2026 KeSPA Cup and posting an 8-1 stretch in recent sets, bolstered by roster additions including deokdam in bot lane, Clozer mid, and Peter support alongside core pieces DuDu and Pyosik. Kiwoom DRX, meanwhile, sit at the bottom of the Rise Group standings with a multi-match losing skid and limited success adapting to the current patch. Head-to-head results favor SOOPers in their most recent encounters, though DRX has shown flashes in objective control and early skirmishes. Both sides face playoff/play-in implications in the double round-robin format, with SOOPers' superior recent form and experience against mid-tier opposition shaping the trader consensus on the series outcome.
